earthRally_window.title: Earth Rally: menu
earthRally_window.desc: Opens or closes the Earth Rally menu (rallies, stages, settings).

earthRally_backOnRoad.title: Earth Rally: back on the road
earthRally_backOnRoad.desc: Puts the car back on the stage's road where it got to, facing on along the stage (+10 s on a timed stage with the reset penalty on).

earthRally_flipUpright.title: Earth Rally: flip upright
earthRally_flipUpright.desc: Turns the car back onto its wheels where it is (no penalty).
